name: Energy Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public energy data.

entries.title: EIA-860 Annual Electric Generator Report
entries.description: Generator-level data on every existing and planned U.S. electric generating unit of 1 MW or more — location, capacity, technology, fuel, and status — collected through Form EIA-860.
entries.attribution: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. Page shows "Release Date: September 10, 2026, Final 2025 data" with an early release of 2026 data due June 2027. The 1 MW threshold and the 1990 start year come from EIA's usual description of the survey and should be confirmed by a steward. EIA publications are public domain (EIA Copyrights and Reuse page).

entries.title: EIA-923 Power Plant Operations Report
entries.description: Monthly and annual plant-level data on U.S. electricity generation, fuel consumption, fuel stocks, and fuel receipts and costs, collected through Form EIA-923 and its predecessors (EIA-906/920).
entries.attribution: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-923
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. Page shows the monthly release of October 23, 2026 (August 2026 data), with the next due end of November 2026, and the annual final 2025 release of September 14, 2026. EIA publications are public domain (EIA Copyrights and Reuse page).

entries.title: EIA Open Data (API v2 and bulk files)
entries.description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration's programmatic access point to its published energy statistics — petroleum, natural gas, coal, electricity, renewables, nuclear, state energy data, and forecasts — through API v2 and bulk download files.

access.auth_note: Free API key via registration on the Open Data page; bulk files need no key.

coverage.spatial: United States (national, state, plant level depending on dataset); some international series

entries.attribution: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Open Data
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. Page offers API key registration under the API Terms of Service and describes the bulk files. EIA's Copyrights and Reuse page (https://www.eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php) states its publications are in the public domain. Cadence is event because series update on their own release schedules.

entries.title: World Bank Energy & Mining Indicators (World Development Indicators)
entries.description: Cross-country energy indicators — electricity access, consumption, renewable share, and energy imports — compiled by the World Bank as part of its World Development Indicators database.
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). IEA and IRENA — the other obvious international energy-statistics bodies — both returned bot-challenge pages (Cloudflare / Azure WAF) on direct fetch this session, the same class of block tracked for BLS/SEC in almanac-template#2. Worth a headless-verified follow-up entry once that fix lands, rather than skipping them. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
